title: Kernel noise operator
statement: For a real parameter $\rho\in[-1,1]$, the kernel noise operator sends a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the function whose value at $x$ is the expectation of $f$ under the noise kernel at $x$. This defines a linear map over $\mathbb{R}$.
